title: The Taliban has taken a terrible toll on the education of girls -- and boys as well
script: A new headline is now getting attention across the news cycle. Reports are focusing on this development: The Taliban has taken a terrible toll on the education of girls -- and boys as well. In simple words, Saturday marks the 5th anniversary of the current Taliban rule in Aghanistan. They've had a devastating impact on girls' education. A lesser told story is their impact on the education of boys Some details may change as more information becomes available, so viewers should check trusted news sources for the newest update.
